ITEM 1 | Dark leafy greens, bright green to deep green, flat irregular leaves with thin stems, lightly dressed with a slight sheen, covering roughly 40% of the plate in a loose mound about 12 cm across and 3 cm tall | 60
ITEM 2 | Thin orange shreds of carrot, bright orange, matchstick-thin about 0.3 cm wide and 4-5 cm long, scattered among the greens | 5
ITEM 3 | Sliced meat, pinkish-red centers with brown seared edges, moist and slightly glossy, cut into thick slices about 1 cm thick and 5-6 cm long, arranged in a fan-like cluster on the right side of the plate covering roughly 15% of the plate | 90
ITEM 4 | Brown glossy pan sauce or dressing, thin amber-brown liquid pooled under and around the meat slices with small bits of golden-brown diced ingredient mixed in, spreading across about 5% of the plate | 15
ITEM 5 | Small pale tan crumbled bits, soft and moist, scattered near the meat and greens at the edge of the plate, about 2 cm across total | 5
